groups.title: Interaction group
groups.description: Groups separate attacks by the pressure they add to the fight. They do not change the difficulty selected in Cuphead.
groups.lightHint: Small attacks for which you can allow larger groups.
groups.strongHint: Attacks that take up more space or demand more attention. You can allow fewer at once.
groups.mini_bossHint: Enemies with their own health. Only one can appear at a time.

helps.extraLifeEffect: Adds a protective heart to Player 1 with the sender's name. Multiple hearts can be stored and are consumed oldest first. They remain between attempts and levels in this session.
helps.ghostEffect: Summons a ghost double of Player 1 for 10 seconds. It floats nearby, visually echoes shots, and doubles all damage dealt. Additional redemptions wait their turn.

challenges.noBombsEffect: Airplane only. Disables bombs and restores your previous weapon afterward. Small-plane shots and supers remain available. Ground-level redemptions wait for an airplane level.
challenges.noPeashooterEffect: Airplane only. The full-size plane uses bombs, then returns to your previous weapon. Small-plane shots and supers remain available. Ground-level redemptions wait for an airplane level.
challenges.rgbShiftEffect: Splits colors and adds blur on ground and airplane levels. Fades in with the active countdown and returns to normal after it reaches zero.
challenges.upsideDownEffect: Smoothly rotates the fight 180° on ground and airplane levels without changing controls, physics, or collisions. Pausing freezes the transition, and the picture returns to normal after reaching zero.
challenges.inkRainEffect: Ink starts raining when the warning ends, without a squid entrance. At zero, new drops stop; existing drops finish falling and the ink clears before the rest period. Ground and airplane.
challenges.miniPlaneOnlyEffect: Airplane only. Mini-plane bullets and supers are allowed. If a normal shot, bomb, or EX damages an enemy, the player who fired it loses one life; native hit invulnerability prevents chained losses.
challenges.hpOneEffect: Ground and airplane. Temporarily lowers each player's current and maximum health to 1 and blocks all healing. Survivors recover exactly the health removed when the timer reaches zero; a defeated or revived player recovers only their normal maximum.
challenges.blackAndWhiteEffect: The picture gently fades to black and white and restores your filter when it ends. Ground and airplane.
challenges.stiffModeEffect: On the ground you cannot walk or dash, but you can move while jumping. In airplane levels it acts as NO MINI-PLANE.
challenges.noDashEffect: Blocks dashing on the ground. In airplane levels it prevents shrinking and returns an already small plane to normal size.
challenges.noExEffect: Blocks EX attacks. Supers remain available. Ground and airplane.
challenges.description: A random challenge is chosen from those you enable, with its own wait time even while other interactions are active. Only one challenge at a time. In airplane levels, NO DASH and STIFF MODE count as a single option.
challenges.waitHint: Default: 5 seconds. Wait first, then the countdown, then the challenge starts. The wait restarts when the previous challenge ends.
challenges.effect: Your attacks deal 50% damage. Ground and airplane.
challenges.durationHint: Recommended: 15 seconds. Choose 1 to 120. Pausing stops the countdown.
challenges.countdownHint: The warning starts after the rest period. Recommended: 3 seconds; 0 skips it. It does not shorten the challenge.

pesky.title: Pesky Mode
pesky.description: Adds random attacks from the interaction catalog during any fight, whether entered normally or through the roulette. You can also configure names to appear randomly with the attacks.

settings.description: Configure the mode's limits, distribution, names and challenge timing.

catalog.title: Available interactions
catalog.description: Enable or disable the interactions that may appear in Pesky Mode.
catalog.unavailable: This interaction is unavailable in the connected mod version.

challengeSettings.title: Timed challenge timing
challengeSettings.description: Set the wait, countdown and duration shared by challenges enabled in the catalog.
challengeSettings.invalid: Use a wait from 0 to 300 seconds, a countdown from 0 to 30, and a duration from 1 to 120.

pesky.interactionsNotice: Interactions are enabled, so donation attacks will continue arriving in addition to this mode's attacks.
pesky.battleBlocked: Pesky Battle has exclusive control. Finish or cancel that battle before enabling the free mode again.

intervals.title: Settings
intervals.description: Adjust interactions and the rest between mini-bosses.
intervals.hint: More seconds = fewer interactions. Use the same value in both for a fixed wait.
intervals.invalid: Use times from {minimum} to {maximum} seconds and enter the lower one first.
intervals.applyBothHint: Use in both copies times, quantities, and the maximum active interactions. The intense interactions option belongs to Pesky Mode.
intervals.previewNone: While a mini-boss is present, this mode will not add regular interactions. Those already on screen finish normally.
intervals.cooldownHint: The countdown starts when the previous one disappears and stops while paused. Regular interactions can continue. Allows 0 to 300 seconds.
intervals.multiplierHint: Choose how many times the normal wait lasts while a mini-boss is present. With 1 it stays the same; with 2 it doubles. A larger number gives you more breathing room.
intervals.companionsHint: How many regular interactions can accompany the mini-boss. With 0, this mode waits for them to clear before adding it and adds no others while it is present. Attacks already on screen finish normally.
intervals.preview: With a mini-boss, the planned wait between other attacks is {minimum} to {maximum} seconds.
intervals.invalidBalance: Use a rest of 0 to 300 seconds, a wait of 1 to 10 times the normal wait, and 0 to 20 extra attacks, using a whole number for the attack count.
intervals.firstMiniBossHint: The first mini-boss can enter as soon as the fight is ready. This wait applies after one disappears.
intervals.summaryNormal: Normally, the planned wait between interactions is {minimum} to {maximum} seconds.
intervals.summaryMiniBoss: With a mini-boss, the wait becomes {minimum}–{maximum} seconds, with up to {count} extra attacks at once.
intervals.summaryCooldown: Once it disappears, at least {seconds} seconds of gameplay must pass before another mini-boss is allowed.
intervals.summaryCooldownRange: After each mini-boss, there will be a wait of between {minimum} and {maximum} seconds of gameplay before another is allowed.
intervals.summaryHint: Waits may be longer if there is no room or the game cannot allow the attack yet.
intervals.allowStrong: Allow multiple intense interactions at once
intervals.allowStrongHint: When unchecked, this mode waits for the current intense attack to finish before adding another.
intervals.singleStrongHint: One intense attack at a time. Saved quantities apply when multiple attacks are allowed.
intervals.batchHint: Choose how many interactions from the same group can arrive together. Each slot draws its actor separately; it repeats only when randomly selected again.
intervals.batchInteractionsHint: Groups attacks that are already waiting; preserves the quantity from each gift.
intervals.batchLimitHint: Available space and each attack's limits still apply. Fewer may appear if there is not enough room for all of them.
intervals.batchInvalid: Use whole numbers from 1 to 20 and enter the lower one first.
intervals.summaryMiniBossOne: With a mini-boss, the wait becomes {minimum}–{maximum} seconds, with up to 1 extra attack at a time.
intervals.summaryNormalFixed: Normally, there is a {seconds}-second wait between interactions.

phaseProtection.title: Transition protection
phaseProtection.description: For the Devil, blocking starts 6 seconds after the phase 1 to 2 signal. For a full comparison, change it before the transformation; it turns back on when the game restarts.

queue.title: Waiting interactions
queue.description: Also shows delivered helps and those waiting internally. Disabling the mode clears pending entries; active ones finish normally.
queue.emptyDescription: Enable Pesky Mode and enter a gameplay level to see generated attacks here.
queue.name: Name

names.title: Random names
names.description: Optional. Enter one name per line; blank lines and duplicates are removed, and each name may contain up to 32 characters. If you leave the list empty, attacks will appear without a name.
names.hint: One name is selected randomly for each attack.
names.emptyHint: No names: attacks will appear without a name.

attacks.title: Available attacks
attacks.description: Check the items that may appear. New catalog items will be enabled automatically.
attacks.required: Enable at least one attack before starting the mode.

helps.description: Choose the helps Pesky Mode may generate for testing. They use a random name from the list; when the list is empty, they appear without a name.

feedback.intervals_saved: The attack times and group sizes were saved.
feedback.invalid_interval: Check the times between attacks and the numbers per appearance.
feedback.blocked_by_pesky_battle: Free Pesky Mode cannot be enabled during a Pesky Battle.
feedback.disabled_by_pesky_battle: Free Pesky Mode was disabled because a Pesky Battle was armed.
feedback.items_required: Enable at least one attack before enabling the mode.
feedback.disabled_invalid_config: The mode was disabled because it needs at least one enabled attack.
feedback.unknown_item: The mod does not recognize this attack.
feedback.native_assets_loading: The attack's assets are still being prepared.
feedback.native_assets_unavailable: The attack's assets could not be prepared.
feedback.requires_gameplay_level: The mode is waiting for a gameplay level.
feedback.spawn_failed: The attack could not be created right now.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.description: Review the available challenges and configure a specific result for the roulette.

challenges.title: Available challenges
challenges.description: Select a challenge to include or remove it from the roulette. At least one must remain active in each category.
challenges.required: At least one challenge must remain active in this category

force.title: Force roulette
force.description: Choose the roulette result to record intros or prepare a specific combination.

status.pending: Applies when you return to the game
